name: Wedding Peach
source:
Story based on anime series depicts the battle with the devils. There is an interactive adventure part and card battles with the opponents. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-march-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事改编自动画《爱天使传说》，描绘爱天使与恶魔的战斗。游戏包含互动冒险部分，以及与敌人进行的卡牌对战。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-march-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
